title: Low-Autocorrelation Binary Sequences (LABS)
summary: Exact witness verification and structured search against audited 2025–2026 LABS energy constructions. Five pending record candidates; scientific review and donor intake paused.

credit.policy: Credit original witness authors per row; credit contributors and AI assistance in result packages and CONTRIBUTORS.md. No authorship promise.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

requirements.note: Python >=3.10; C++17 and make for solver. No GPU or external Python packages.
